# LegatorOCR 0.2.0-pre.62

- **"At the middle" no longer cuts into the text:** on a spread whose spine is a little off-centre (the cut at exactly half the width sliced the beginnings of the right page's lines), the cut now moves into the gutter when a clear one lies within 10% of the width of the middle; otherwise it stays exactly at the middle. "Automatic" and the dragged cut line are unchanged.
- Fractal paper/ink textures for the synthetic test pages (`tools/ocr-train`, `FRACTAL=1`): developer tool only, not part of the application.

Known: tested on synthetic spreads only; on the tester's real project the effect has not been checked.
